feeds.title: The Crochet Crowd
feeds.description: The Crochet Crowd is about community first. Led by Michael Sellick, aka Mikey. Our goal is to provide free resources such as crochet patterns, video tutorials, and more.

feeds.title: Oombawka Design Crochet
feeds.description: Find hundreds of free crochet patterns, step-by-step photo tutorials, video tutorials, crochet along (CALs), and crochet pattern roundups at Oombawka Design Crochet.

feeds.title: SweetGeorgia Yarns Blog » Crochet
feeds.description: Unapologetic colour and craft since 2005. This section features articles on crochet. SweetGeorgia is an artisan yarn and fibre arts company that creates luxury hand-dyed yarn, fibre, patterns, goods, and education for a global community to bring joy through colour and craft.

feeds.title: The Loopy Lamb
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Ashley. I'm a crochet designer that lives in Ontario, Canada. On my blog, I share my crochet projects, patterns, and crafting ideas. I hope I inspire you to make something beautiful and fun.

feeds.title: PlanetJune Blog
feeds.description: Hello! My name is June Gilbank, and I'm a crochet pattern designer, crochet and craft book author, multi-crafter, technical writer, and animal lover. Find posts on crochet designs and tutorials, craft projects, running a craft business, PlanetJune news, and wildlife and nature.

feeds.title: Akroche Tatuk Blog
feeds.description: Akroche Tatuk, specializes in winter accessories as well as beginner-to-intermediate level patterns that are simple and quick to work up. My catalog also offers shawls, pullovers, ecofriendly projects, home accessories, and more.

feeds.title: MJ's off the Hook Designs Blog
feeds.description: MJ's Off the Hook Designs is your one stop for crochet information, projects, and patterns. Specializing in Crochet patterns, kits, luxury yarns, and finished products!

feeds.title: CocoCrochetLee
feeds.description: Lee Sartori is the crochet designer behind CoCo Crochet Lee. She can be seen as a guest host on Season 9 -11 of the popular PBS Show Knit and Crochet Now, as well as a cast member of Annie's Creative Studio where she demonstrates fun crochet skills and patterns. Lee's passion is designing modern, wearable garments, and adorable amigurumi.

feeds.title: All About Ami Blog
feeds.description: Beautiful, modern and cute crochet, amigurumi, and knit patterns by Stephanie Jessica Lau! Free patterns and detailed step-by-step tutorials are available!

feeds.title: A[mi]dorable Crochet
feeds.description: Jackie lives in B.C. Canada and enjoys playing with yarn and creating amis in her spare time. She started crocheting in 2009, and has been hooked ever since! Jackie finds inspiration from family and friends, her favorite TV shows, movies and music!

feeds.title: SummerBug Crafts Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Summer! In 2015, I picked up a crochet hook and got started on my journey! 6 years later, I design my own crochet patterns which are available for free, and sell the cuties I create! Not only that, but I write blogs to help you get started with crochet and to avoid the mistakes I made. I struggled for years to find my crochet 'niche'. I finally stumbled upon the Japanese art of crocheting tiny animals (amigurumi) and fell in love. I knew this was where I belonged, and that I could channel my love of anime and video games into this craft.

feeds.title: ACCROchet
feeds.description: Original, colourful, modern crochet pattern designs. Product, yarn, book reviews. Pattern and corporate translations and revisions and articles about much more.

feeds.title: By Stephanie Erin Blog
feeds.description: Stephanie Erin is an experienced crochet and tunisian crochet pattern designer. She focuses on modern design elements that make knitters want to pick up a hook.

feeds.title: The Stitchery Blog
feeds.description: Check out our blog for news and all things yarn! We will feature new products - yarn, hooks, needles, specialty items - as well as links to other great online yarn shops. Stop by The Stitchery for your knitting and crochet needs. Join in on the KAL Knitterati Knit-Along by Cascade Yarns.

feeds.title: Sincerely Pam
feeds.description: I'm Pam. Aside from my kids, this little site is my absolute pride and joy. Here I will share with you my newest free designs, helpful tutorials, and products I can't live without. Feel free to browse around, try a pattern or two and make sure to come back often.

feeds.title: sukigirl
feeds.description: Crochet projects and all things that are related to this wonderful hobby.

feeds.title: Tinderbox Blog
feeds.description: I'm Courtney. My Tinderbox is filled with hooks, yarn, notions, and poorly drawn sketches-everything I need to start my own little fire. Here on my website (and elsewhere), I make my designs available to you, so that you can start a little fire to keep you warm wherever you go, too. Happy adventuring!
